verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's Coach is a built-in assistant that users can talk to inside Lorikeet. It can 'implement improvements on your behalf', which is a documented in-product delegation path. However, the delegable scope is only shown for quality and improvement work. Most other agentic task evidence (building workflows, running simulations, diagnosing tickets) runs through the external MCP server in Claude or ChatGPT rather than an in-product assistant. missing for 10: documented breadth of tasks delegable to the in-product assistant beyond Coach's improvement suggestions, evidence that workflow building, simulations and diagnosis can be delegated from inside the Lorikeet UI rather than via external MCP clients, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Talk to Coach wherever you work, whether in Lorikeet, Slack, Claude, ChatGPT, or via MCP.
Coach can implement improvements on your behalf, or make suggestions for you to action yourself.
Coach reviews 100% of tickets against your quality standards and turns findings into fixes
